summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a high score of 73 for the liver and a low score of 41 for the heart [M]. Out of 10 total trials, search results show that some were stopped early for reasons not related to safety [3][4]. For example, one trial ended for non-safety reasons, another closed due to slow recruitment, and a third stopped because data analysis was pending [4][5][6].
